subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.------V.SY.
description: Second diagram on page 265 (PR.S(RD)II-19), paired with TH-CONT × AF-COMP above. The crossing diagrams how multi-information structurally meets value-system at the journalism-insensitivity scale the prior diagram named: MT-INFO (multi-information) crossed with V-SY (value system — the partner-axis's organized value-system that determines acceptance). MT-INFO sits at upper-left with the subject-arrow; V-SY sits centrally below as partner-axis. AFL (affinity alignment) branches up to the right from the main line and carries OBS (observation) and INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), which carries PER-DY (perception dynamics). CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis) branches to the left and carries PRI-INFO (principle information) and DEF (definition). SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) branches to the right and carries AFI (affinity insight), which carries ATTN (attraction), which carries RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits).
